system.description: Even if in full view of a creature, your successful stealth task allows you to slip away from that creature and hide from view in a nearby shadow, behind a tree or furnishing, or in the next room as your action. Effort: Attempt to slip away from one additional target looking directly at you (attempt a separate stealth task against each). Enabler. At tier 3: You can attempt to hide from two additional creatures, whether or not you use Effort.
